scripts.dev: npm run codegen && concurrently -n shared,server,client "tsc -b shared -w --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @ricportal/server" "npm run dev -w @ricportal/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run codegen && concurrently -n shared,server "tsc -b shared -w --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @ricportal/server"
scripts.test:unit: npm run codegen && vitest run --project unit
scripts.build: npm run codegen && tsc -b && npm run build -w @ricportal/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
